name: wapisender-mcp

tools.name: login
tools.description: Load saved credentials and connect to your WapiSender account. Auto-selects instance if you only have one.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Clear the current WapiSender session.

tools.name: list_instances
tools.description: List all WhatsApp instances on your WapiSender account with their status.

tools.name: switch_instance
tools.description: Set the active instance by name or ID. All subsequent tool calls will use this instance.

tools.name: get_instance_status
tools.description: Get the current connection status of the active WhatsApp instance — connection state, phone number, battery level.

tools.name: get_qr_code
tools.description: Get the QR code for connecting a WhatsApp number to the active instance. Scan this with WhatsApp on your phone.

tools.name: send_text
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp text message to a phone number.

to.description: Phone number with country code, e.g. 5491112345678

tools.name: send_media
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp media message (image, video, or document) with an optional caption.

url.description: Publicly accessible URL of the media file

tools.name: send_location
tools.description: Send a WhatsApp location pin to a phone number.

tools.name: list_contacts
tools.description: List contacts on the active instance with optional search.

search.description: Search by name or phone number

tools.name: get_contact
tools.description: Get a single contact by phone number.

tools.name: upsert_contact
tools.description: Create or update a contact on the active instance.

tools.name: list_flows
tools.description: List all flows on the active instance with their status (active/draft).

tools.name: get_flow
tools.description: Get the full definition and health status of a specific flow.

tools.name: create_flow
tools.description: Create a new empty flow on the active instance.

tools.name: update_flow_definition
update_flow_node
tools.description: Edit a single node's configuration within an existing flow without touching other nodes.

data.description: New data object for the node

tools.name: generate_and_save_flow

description.description: Plain-English description of the flow behavior

tools.name: activate_flow
tools.description: Enable a flow so it processes incoming WhatsApp messages. Runs a health check first.

tools.name: deactivate_flow
tools.description: Disable a flow. Incoming messages will no longer be processed by it.

tools.name: get_webhook
tools.description: Get the current webhook configuration for the active instance.

tools.name: set_webhook
tools.description: Set the webhook URL and events for the active instance.

events.description: Event types to subscribe to, e.g. ["MESSAGES_UPSERT"]

tools.name: list_ai_credentials
tools.description: List saved AI provider credentials for the active instance. API keys are masked.

tools.name: add_ai_credential
tools.description: Add a new AI provider credential for the active instance. The API key is encrypted server-side and never stored locally.

apiKey.description: Provider API key — encrypted server-side immediately

defaultModel.description: Default model to use, e.g. gpt-4o-mini

tools.name: test_ai_credential
tools.description: Send a live test ping to verify a saved AI credential works.
